baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of believing, then covering, then a passive stamp on hearts, followed by failure to understand.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settling assent opens a trusted orientation; subsequent covering and disowning reverse that orientation. The stamp makes the reversal durable on a heart whose own branch inventory includes turning, so failed understanding is the downstream effect of a stabilized turn rather than a simple information deficit.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the initially trusted orientation that is later reversed.
Covering supplies the closing action performed after assent.
Disowning sharpens the cover into withdrawal from an acknowledged commitment.
A seal that leaves an image turns the preceding withdrawal into a durable condition.
Turning a thing from one face to another makes the heart the normally reversible element that becomes fixed.
Understanding names the capacity lost when the heart can no longer revise its orientation.

changed_reading.before: They believed, later ceased believing, and were punished with incomprehension.
changed_reading.after: A trusted assent is covered and disowned; that reversal is impressed as a durable direction on a normally turnable heart, so subsequent sense-making cannot reopen it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The stamp falls upon the hearts and is immediately explained by their not understanding.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fullness branch of the stamp root permits a container model alongside the ordinary seal model. An engulfing cover fills the inner core to its limit, leaving no receptive interval in which a meaning can be grasped. This makes incomprehension a saturation effect, not an empty or inactive mind.

activation_trace.role: An engulfing cover supplies the material that occupies rather than merely caps the interior.
Filling to the utmost recasts the stamp as saturation to a limit.
The pure inner core locates saturation at the center from which discernment would operate.
Grasping a meaning is the receptive operation crowded out by the filled core.

changed_reading.before: The heart is closed by a lid-like seal.
changed_reading.after: The heart may also be imagined as full to its limit: prior covering occupies the core so completely that new meaning has nowhere to take hold.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A stamp is applied to hearts whose root also denotes reversal, and the result is absence of understanding.
baseline_models.mechanism: A die or exemplar forces repeated matter into one measure, while a heart normally turns an issue over from face to face. Their collision yields a cognitive mechanism: a fixed template reproduces the same reading of each input and disables the comparison and revision needed for understanding.

activation_trace.role: The exemplar and imposed measure supply a fixed interpretive template.
Turning between faces supplies the counter-capacity that the fixed template suppresses.
Understanding requires the flexible comparison that a single imposed measure prevents.

changed_reading.before: The seal simply blocks access to understanding.
changed_reading.after: The seal acts like a die: inputs still arrive, but the heart prints the same preformed reading instead of turning them over.

context_deltas.mechanism: The public testimony of 63:1 operates as an entrance that admits true words, while the concealed-exit branch of hypocrisy preserves a route out of their obligation. In 63:2, oaths and a protective shield make that routing repeatable. The focus sequence can therefore describe an operational switch repeatedly enacted within speech and conduct, before the stamp fixes the practiced route.

activation_trace.role: Assent that settles the heart is the commitment admitted through the visible entrance.
Disowning supplies the concealed withdrawal from what the mouth admitted.
The impressed seal stabilizes a route first practiced as reversible speech.
Showing an entrance while hiding an exit supplies the two-channel architecture of their confession.
Uttered speech provides the public channel in which assent becomes audible.
Knowledge-bearing testimony raises the force of the spoken admission and the counter-testimony exposing it.
The oath supplies a formal speech instrument that can be deployed without inward adherence.
A protective shield makes speech a defense that blocks accountability rather than opening understanding.

structural_cues: In 63:1 the proposition spoken by the hypocrites is true, yet their testimony is exposed as lying at the level of commitment.
In 63:2 the oaths are explicitly taken as a shield and are followed by turning others from the path.
The focus ayah follows these two speech scenes with belief, then disbelief, then the passive stamp.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies admitted testimony, a hidden exit, oaths, and a shield; I infer that 'then' can name a recurrent switch from verbal admission to protected withdrawal. A materially live alternative is a single chronological passage from belief to disbelief.

changed_reading.before: They sincerely believed at one past time and later apostatized.
changed_reading.after: Their public assent functions as an entrance while a concealed exit and oath-shield prevent that assent from binding action; repeated switching is eventually fixed as the heart's route.

context_deltas.mechanism: Verse 63:4 rules out a merely sensory deficit: their speech is heard, and they themselves register every alarming sound. The propped timber image supplies a rigid form held from outside, while their supposition classifies every shout as directed against them. The stamp-as-template baseline is thus strengthened into a threat classifier that receives signals but cannot turn them into alternative explanations.

activation_trace.role: An imposed exemplar supplies the one template through which incoming signals are classified.
Turning an issue between faces is the missing interpretive alternative-making capacity.
Understanding distinguishes meaningful interpretation from bare signal registration.
Audibly produced speech shows that articulate output remains available despite failed understanding.
Perception of sound establishes intact sensory intake rather than deafness.
Rigid timber supplies matter that retains an outward form without self-directed responsiveness.
Dependence and leaning show the rigid form being maintained by external support.
Supposition supplies the inferential act that assigns one threatening meaning to every input.
The alarming shout is the variable input repeatedly forced into the same hostile class.
Being turned from a proper face echoes the heart's failed capacity to reverse a mistaken reading.

structural_cues: Their bodies impress and their speech attracts listening before they are compared to propped timber.
They take every shout to be against them, showing active but invariant interpretation.
The verse ends with a passive question about how they are turned away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intact speech and hearing, externally supported rigidity, supposition, and repeated threat attribution; I infer a fixed classification template rather than absent input. The timber may alternatively mark only inner emptiness, and the final turning may remain a general moral description.

changed_reading.before: They do not understand because the sealed heart receives nothing.
changed_reading.after: Signals enter and speech exits, but a rigid heart-template assigns every signal the same self-protective meaning; incomprehension is failed reinterpretation, not failed sensation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places two kinds of covering in opposition. Their own covering hides or disowns, whereas forgiveness is a cover that protects from the consequence of fault. When the protective cover is offered, they twist their heads, turn away, and magnify themselves; the subsequent equivalence of asking or not asking marks a reached threshold. The heart-stamp can therefore be read as the inward fixation of an enacted refusal of the counter-cover.

activation_trace.role: Self-protective covering supplies one side of the contrast between two covers.
The seal records the refusal as a durable inward state.
The heart's turning branch connects the visible turn-away to an interior orientation.
Covering the fault while protecting its bearer supplies the rejected remedial cover.
Twisting something until it deviates makes refusal a visible directional action.
The head localizes the outward twist that mirrors the inward turn.
Turning away and diverting completes the refusal initiated by the twisted head.
Self-magnification supplies the motive that makes corrective reorientation intolerable.
Repeated protective covering, now declared unavailable, marks the consequence after refusal.

structural_cues: The invitation to seek forgiveness is answered by a bodily twist of the head and deliberate turning away.
Verse 63:6 makes requesting forgiveness and not requesting it equivalent for this group.
The focus's passive seal stands between prior shield-making and the later refusal of remediation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed cover images, a bodily twist, turning away, pride, and a later threshold; I infer that repeated external refusal becomes an interior fixed direction. A live alternative is that the seal is wholly a subsequent sanction with no habituation mechanism implied.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief is one undifferentiated covering followed by an imposed seal.
changed_reading.after: They choose a hiding cover while physically refusing the protective cover of forgiveness; the seal fixes that chosen direction once remediation has been persistently turned away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Verse 63:7 exposes a specific failed causal model: stop resource outflow and the people around the messenger will disperse. The treasury image breaks the premise that the speakers control the relevant supply, and the repeated failure of fiqh names their inability to grasp that larger system. The stamped heart becomes a closed ledger that can count only locally controlled exits.

activation_trace.role: The imposed measure supplies a fixed accounting template for social causality.
The inner core locates the closed model at the center of judgment and intention.
Understanding in the focus is specified by the later failure to grasp a resource-and-cohesion relation.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the controlled outflow in their proposed strategy.
A gathering breaking apart supplies the social outcome they think withholding will cause.
Guarded reserves widen the accounting frame beyond the resources the speakers can withhold.
The exact recurrence of failed understanding diagnoses the error in their causal ledger.

structural_cues: Their command explicitly links withholding expenditure to the dispersal of the messenger's companions.
The counterstatement relocates the treasuries of provision beyond their control.
The verse ends with the same failure of fiqh that closes the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies resource outflow, group dispersal, treasuries, and repeated non-understanding; I infer that the seal is a closed causal ledger unable to represent provision outside local control. The live alternative is that the repeated fiqh formula remains a general rebuke without specifying a cognitive model.

changed_reading.before: They fail to understand religious truth in general.
changed_reading.after: Their stamped model specifically misreads social provision: it treats controlled spending as the sole cause of cohesion and cannot register a treasury beyond their ledger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Verse 63:8 gives the fixed template propositional content: return to the city, then the dominant party expels the abased party. The verse preserves the return/exit geometry but reverses the ownership of might. Their lack of knowledge is therefore an inability to flip a rank assignment even when the stated hierarchy is countered, strengthening the die-against-reversal model.

activation_trace.role: An imposed exemplar supplies the rigid hierarchy through which return and expulsion are read.
Turning a thing to another face is the exact revision their rank script cannot perform.
Understanding would require grasping the reversal of apparent and actual rank.
Return to a prior place supplies the first movement in their spatial-political script.
Penetrating to the outside supplies the expulsion by which the script enforces rank.
Dominance and overpowering name the rank claimed by the speakers and reassigned by the counterstatement.
Brokenness under domination supplies the lower slot in their binary hierarchy.
Failure of disclosure to the knower confirms that the corrected ownership of might does not become cognitively available to them.

structural_cues: The boast has a compact return-then-expulsion sequence with two opposed rank positions.
The answer does not erase might but reassigns it to God, the messenger, and the believers.
The closing formula shifts from not understanding in 63:7 to not knowing in 63:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a spatial rank script and an explicit reassignment of dominance; I infer that the focus seal prevents flipping the role assignment while allowing the script itself to persist. Alternatively, 63:8 may only report a boast and its theological correction without describing the seal's operation.

changed_reading.before: The heart is sealed against an unspecified truth.
changed_reading.after: The heart preserves a rigid dominance script: it can imagine return and expulsion but cannot reverse who truly occupies the mighty and abased positions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later address to believers supplies a preventative analogue to the focus condition. Wealth can multiply and occupy attention, displacing active remembrance; delayed corrective action then meets a fixed term that cannot be deferred. This revises the saturation baseline into a path-dependent process in which rival contents fill the core until reorientation reaches a terminal boundary.

activation_trace.role: Fullness to a limit supplies the terminal state toward which accumulated distraction moves.
The inner core is the limited field progressively occupied by rival concerns.
Understanding is the displaced operation once attention is saturated.
Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies the attentional displacement mechanism.
Accumulating wealth supplies a growing rival content rather than a neutral possession.
Bringing something back to presence supplies the orientation displaced by distraction.
Commercial loss reverses the apparent gain of accumulation and exposes the bad valuation.
Seeking delay supplies the failed attempt to reopen action after saturation has matured.
The fixed endpoint supplies the terminal boundary beyond which reorientation is not deferred.

structural_cues: Verse 63:9 changes addressee to believers, so its mechanism is analogical and preventative rather than a direct description of the hypocrites.
Wealth and children are named as potential distractors from remembrance, followed by a loss formula.
Verses 63:10-11 place expenditure before death and deny delay once the fixed term arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distraction, accumulation, displaced remembrance, requested delay, and a fixed endpoint; I infer a trajectory from attentional occupation to terminal fullness. The audience shift remains a real limit: these verses may warn believers without explaining how the earlier seal arose.

changed_reading.before: The seal is an instantaneous closure imposed after disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The seal can coexist with a process reading: competing attachments progressively occupy the core, corrective reorientation is deferred, and fullness becomes terminal at a fixed boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the river and well branches of the focus roots and joins them to tunnels, expenditure, dispersal, treasuries, and rain across distant domains. It remains anchored in the focus's stamp-on-hearts construction and the surah's repeated outflow language, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for blocked circulation, not as the lexical meaning of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The stamp root can image a full or running river, the heart root can image a well, and the result is failure of understanding.

activation_trace.role: A running or excavated river supplies the unexpected flow-domain activation within the stamped clause.
A well supplies an interior reservoir whose access or circulation can be blocked.
Understanding is recast, cautiously, as successful circulation through the inner reservoir.
A tunnel with an outlet supplies hidden channel geometry around the focus's blocked interior.
A flowing dispersal image lets social scattering register as material leaving a channel.
A protected reserve supplies the upstream store that exceeds local attempts to dam outflow.
Money exiting in expenditure supplies the demanded reopening of beneficial flow.
Provision as descending rain completes the exploratory hydraulic circuit of source, store, channel, and outflow.

changed_reading.before: The seal is a static lid over a cognitive organ.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the seal is a blockage in an inner water system: hidden channels remain, but trust, meaning, and provision no longer circulate through the heart in an open course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is cross-domain because it connects the stamp inventory's coin-imaging scope and the heart's mold branch to the later treasury, wealth, trade-loss, and apportioned-gift sequence. Those branches visibly support a value-imprinting analogy anchored in the focus seal, but downstream prose should qualify it as an exploratory account of valuation, not claim that the verse literally calls the heart a coin or mint.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The heart is stamped by a root whose seal branch includes imaging coinage, and its own root includes a casting mold; failed understanding follows.

activation_trace.role: The sealing-and-imaging branch, including coin impression in its scope, supplies a minted valuation template.
A mold into which matter is poured supplies the heart as a form that reproduces one scale of value.
Failed understanding becomes inability to reassess what actually counts as gain, supply, and worth.
Guarded treasuries expose a supply horizon larger than the locally stamped scarcity model.
Accumulated wealth supplies the quantity that the fixed value-template overweights.
Trade loss overturns the apparent profit generated by that valuation.
An apportioned gift relocates value from possession to received and releasable provision.

changed_reading.before: The stamp blocks recognition without specifying the misvaluation it preserves.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the stamped heart mints a scarcity-and-status scale: accumulated holdings appear as gain, withholding as control, and a wider treasury or gain-through-giving cannot be valued.

strongest_changes: The belief-then-disbelief sequence became a repeatedly usable two-exit switch: true words enter public speech while a hidden route withdraws commitment.
The seal became a fixed classifier rather than sensory closure: speech and sound still pass, but every input is printed as self-protective threat.
The repeated failure of fiqh in 63:7 specified a closed causal ledger that mistakes controlled expenditure for control over cohesion and provision.
The later distraction and deadline sequence kept alive a second process model in which occupation of attention grows toward terminal fullness.
summary.what_was_special: The packet supported several coexisting mechanics without requiring a single lexical choice: seal, saturation, die, refused protective cover, closed ledger, and two contained material outliers. Most distinctive was the N-F-Q activation across hypocrisy's hidden exit and money's outward expenditure, which made controlled passage rather than mere concealment central to the changed reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus's 'then' may be strictly biographical rather than recurrent or operational.
The passive stamp may denote only a subsequent divine sanction rather than the fixation of a practiced habit.
The saturation model is branch-licensed but less syntactically immediate than sealing in the construction used.
The hydraulic and minting models should remain exploratory analogies and must not be used to disambiguate the verse's lexical sense.
Because 63:9-11 address believers, their attention-and-deadline mechanism may be preventative analogy rather than explanation of the hypocrites' state.
